info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cheque Lock Box Management API
info.description: The Cheque Lock Box Management API enables efficient handling and management of cheque deposits through a secure lock box system. This service allows businesses to deposit cheques electronically, streamlining reconciliation processes and improving cash flow management. Typical consumers include financial institutions and corporate clients seeking a reliable method to manage incoming payments. With the API, users can perform actions related to cheque processing and tracking, ensuring that funds are captured accurately and promptly.

post.summary: Create a new cheque lock box.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new cheque lock box in the trade banking system. By providing the necessary details, you can securely set up a new lock box for managing incoming cheques.
